description: The hardest rung. Built like L04 but with five extra crate stacks and an additional acceptance test: the layout is redrawn until the widest-path bottleneck of the whole arena falls inside `target_corridor_width_m`, so the narrow passage is MEASURED rather than hand-placed. A crate is also required on the final approach to occlude the goal. Why rejection sampling rather than placing a gate directly: a 2.4 m rack in a 6 m-wide arena cannot simultaneously cross the y = 0 centre line (required, so static mode stays discriminative) and leave a sub-0.7 m gap to the far wall -- the two constraints are algebraically incompatible for a single rack. A narrow gate therefore has to emerge from a combination of bodies, and searching for it against the measured descriptor is both simpler and more honest than asserting a geometry that does not hold. Expected to be the hardest layout; included so the ladder has a rung where a drop is anticipated rather than surprising.
